row.evidence: Framer's pricing page lists SCIM and SSO only under Enterprise ("Mission critical sites", "Custom"), above Basic ($10/month) and Pro ($30/month).
row.notes: Framer prices per site, not per user: Basic $10/mo and Pro $30/mo per site on yearly billing, plus $20/mo per additional editor ($10 per content editor); Basic and Pro cap edit seats at 10. Per-user fields are null for that reason. SCIM and SSO are Enterprise-only (Custom pricing). Framer publishes no SCIM setup docs; the Entra gallery app covers SAML SSO only. The Server API publishes project content and has no documented user or member endpoints.
